basic_profile.bio: Based in Toronto, I'm an urban planner by profession with a keen interest in sustainable city design and infrastructure. I love tinkering with tech gadgets and often help friends and family troubleshoot their tech issues. My online presence is quite significant as I browse Reddit during my commute and late evenings after work. Currently single and enjoying the city life, I spend weekends exploring new urban spaces and occasionally contribute to local community planning discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's degree in Urban Planning from a Canadian university. My expertise lies in urban design and sustainable development, which I further enrich through self-teaching and attending industry seminars. I'm also well-versed in consumer tech due to personal interest and practical experience.
